tools.name: compare_coins

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: Returns the sector names StrictScore uses. Call it before get_rankings when the user names a sector, and pass the value unchanged. Takes no arguments: {}.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Returns the 10 biggest 24h gainers and 10 biggest 24h losers among StrictScore-covered assets, with scores and page URLs. Use it for "what moved today". Not for score-based screening (use get_rankings) or overall market conditions (use get_market_health). Takes no arguments: {}.

tools.name: get_market_health
tools.description: Returns the StrictScore Market Health Score (0-100), danger index, regime label (capitulation, risk_off, neutral, risk_on, froth), the five component scores, a one-line verdict, the snapshot time and degraded-data flags.
